pages.lines:
RENTAL OFFERS
Nightly & Seasonal
AMENITIES
Catamaran Park has a lot to offer!
Catamaran has over 80 nightly rental sites and over 200 seasonal sites. This family operated park boosts over 5 state of the art playgrounds throughout the park, fully maintained beach area, restaurant/take-out, indoor pool, mini-golf, an entertainment building, dog park, soccer pitch, skate park, and boat launch area. This park offers a one of a kind family vacation!
01
Explore the Park
Catamaran Park has over 20 roads/areas to explore. Most contain both nightly and seasonal rentals, and a few sections have only seasonal rentals. Badger Lake Resort and Road to the Lake have the 50 amp serviced sites. Tenters Delight hosts 13 tent sites. Sunshine Square has 28 open / drive through sites. All of the other sites are at least 30 amp serviced. There are 2 main comfort stations and several modern outhouse style washrooms around the park. In case of emergency there are fire stations and drinking water areas throughout the park.
